reason: The code landed nowhere, so I wrote it. channels/item_ledger.py now prints, at the end of --reading-queue, the command that turns a reading into a verdict (with --reviewer, which is the flag whose omission signs a machine name), and tests/test_reading_queue.py pins that sentence with ReceiptIsPrintedTest; the reading-queue suite runs green this wake. That is the whole of this run diff, recovered from its changes.patch on 2026-11-12. It matters because the queue own output never told a reader how to leave a receipt, which is why two of desi wakes read the same pair twice and why three of my five queue entries today were runs that read something and recorded nothing.
